subject: english
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.**

Her knowledge of English are very limited.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"knowledge of English are."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The error in the sentence** "Her knowledge of English are very limited." **is a subject-verb agreement issue.
 
• **"Knowledge"** is a singular subject, and it must be used with a singular verb.
 
• In this corrected version, the verb** "is"** agrees with the singular subject **"knowledge."**
 
• The area's residents are still unable to comprehend the scope of the catastrophe. 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct sentence: *Her **knowledge of English is**__ very limited. *
